spec_match.rationale: Exercises §5.3.2 exactly: window.requestResize() from an opted-in child updates the host's internal layout intrinsic size, and the NotAllowedError contract is probed at two of the spec's algorithm steps — a top-level window (not a child navigable) and a child whose responsive-embedded-sizing flag is unset. The one-shot snapshot (§5.3.1: set at DOMContentLoaded/load, later changes inert) is demonstrated by growing child content without calling the method.

interactive.rationale: Parent buttons drive the child via same-origin postMessage commands (grow / grow+requestResize / reset), a live ResizeObserver readout compares iframe box vs child-reported natural height, and two explicit error-probe buttons fill an observed-results table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the one-shot demonstration plus the NotAllowedError probes from top-level and non-opted-in contexts; the page has precisely those controls.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes four outcomes per probe: threw NotAllowedError (pass), threw something else (fail), did not throw (spec violation), and window.requestResize undefined (honest unsupported fallback, explicitly labelled as not a NotAllowedError). The child reports requestResize-missing rather than pretending the resize happened.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5108373464547328 and the spec's dom-window-requestresize anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts typeof window.requestResize === 'function' and the top-level NotAllowedError contract as executable assertions that fail honestly (observed FAIL with detail 'typeof = undefined' / false on Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CLI + CDP: autorun drove grow, grow+requestResize, the top-level probe and the no-meta probe; observed child natural height 284px (3 blocks) vs iframe box 154px with the honest 'requestResize-missing' child error and 'window.requestResize is undefined' probe rows; zero console errors; fonts failures environmental. The success path (box following requestResize, actual NotAllowedError throws) requires a ResponsiveIframes-enabled 153 build and was NOT observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Distinct asserts per branch: responsive-iframe-one-shot-snapshot and responsive-iframe-request-resize-applies on the supported path; responsive-iframe-request-resize-unsupported-fallback, responsive-iframe-toplevel-throw(s)-notallowed / -unsupported-fallback, and the no-meta equivalents on fallback/error branches — fallbacks never reuse the success ids.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; secondary button overrides background AND color together; focus-visible outlines; fixed-layout tables with overflow-wrap.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, titled iframes, aria-live polite readout and observed-results cells, results conveyed as text (pass/fail words, not colour alone), table caption + th scope on both axes.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated: zero horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; controls wrap via flex-wrap with 44px min-height; mobile and desktop screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify requestResize() semantics on an implementing build
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153/Canary with ResponsiveIframes enabled, confirm: (a) grow-only leaves the box at the load-time snapshot while grow+requestResize() moves it to the new natural height; (b) the top-level and no-meta probes actually throw NotAllowedError DOMExceptions (the conformance assertion requestresize-toplevel-throws-notallowederror should flip to PASS); (c) whether reset+requestResize() shrinks the box (the spec sets the intrinsic size from the scrolling area, so shrinking should work — record observed behaviour).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates for measurement readouts
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Tie dynamic outcome announcements to the activating control with polite live regions; keep outcomes textual.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the dynamic readout and both observed-results cells are aria-live polite and word their verdicts (threw NotAllowedError / is undefined / does not match) rather than relying on colour.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel side by side comparison no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows with flex-wrap and gap; give long monospace content overflow handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .controls is flex-wrap with gap; tables are table-layout:fixed with overflow-wrap:anywhere; CDP confirmed zero overflow at 360px.

summary: Covers the dynamic half of the feature: the deliberate one-shot snapshot, the requestResize() escape hatch, and the method's NotAllowedError gatekeeping at two spec algorithm steps, with a message-driven child that always reports its own state honestly (including requestResize-missing on pre-153 browsers). Chromium 141 verification exercised every control through the autorun hook on the fallback branch; enabled-path verification is the open item.
